title: READABLE CAPTURE TITLE AND RECORDING BADGE
why: The critic found recorded station text behind the attract title and a low wake prompt; the camera found the fixed 15px badge too small at 4K. Watch: f9 now records your whole run; when nobody touches the game it plays all your recordings
now: Recorded footage has opaque title and prompt backplates, a higher 32px prompt and a recording badge that scales from 20px to 40px between 1080p and 4K. LOCAL: no linked review.
